name: tmux-server
title: tmux server controls
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Inspect or explicitly stop the separate vqro-owned tmux server.
description: Not supported on native Windows; run vqro inside WSL to use tmux. Adds independent server status and a confirmed stop action, even while the tmux provider is disabled. Stop ends the owned server and its terminal programs; no server is started just to inspect it. Turn this extension off to remove its controls, not to stop the server. It never stops a configured external tmux server.

menu_items: vqro-owned tmux server, only while present
